questions.skill: 区分并行规则、直接冲突与领域排除
questions.q: A federal air-safety code exclusively regulates emergency signals. A city adopted a similar signal rule. Although the city's rule was not shown to contradict a specific clause, a court set it aside because the code already covered the entire field. Why?
o: The city rule was barred because national law already occupied the field.
The federal code was cancelled because the city's provisions ran parallel.
The court ordered the city to enforce its rule beside the national code.
The judges delayed a decision until the national agency reviewed its budget.

exp.trans: 一套联邦航空安全规范对紧急信号作了专属规定。某市采用了类似规则。尽管没有证明市级规则直接违反特定条文，法院仍因联邦规范已全面覆盖该领域而排除了市级规定。
exp.structure: Although引导让步：没有证明逐条直接矛盾；主句a court set it aside给出判决；because说明真正理由是整个领域已由上级规则全面规制。
exp.other: exclusively 专属地；signal 信号；contradict 与……相矛盾；set aside 废除、排除；occupy the field 通过全面规制排除下级立法。
exp.meaning: 并行或类似不等于相抵触；领域排除的判断依据是整个领域已由上级法律覆盖，不要求指出某条具体文字直接冲突。
exp.rest: 没有推翻联邦规范；法院没有命令城市同时执行两套规则；也没有推迟判决等待预算审查。

questions.q: If the wind weakens before noon, the ferry could conceivably resume service this afternoon, but the operator has made no promise. Conceivably most nearly means:
o: 必然地
有这种可能，但不能确定
故意地
表面上地

exp.trans: 如果中午前风势减弱，渡轮今天下午有可能恢复运营，但运营方没有作出任何保证。
exp.structure: if从句给出条件：the wind weakens before noon。主句：the ferry + could resume + service；conceivably修饰could resume，降低确定性。but后面的no promise进一步说明并不确定。
exp.other: weaken 减弱；ferry 渡轮；resume service 恢复运营；operator 运营方。
exp.meaning: conceivably = 可以设想地、有可能地，强调可能存在但远未确定。
exp.rest: 必然地接近certainly/inevitably，语气过强；故意地是deliberately/intentionally；表面上地是apparently/superficially，均不符合could...but no promise的弱可能语境。

questions.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
questions.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。

questions.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

questions.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
questions.q: Engineers who noticed that the valve was leaking shut down the line. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Engineers / noticed / shut down
the valve / noticed / was leaking
Engineers / was leaking / noticed
the line / shut down / noticed

exp.trans: 注意到阀门漏液的工程师关闭了生产线。按题目要求的顺序，主句主语中心词是Engineers，who从句谓语是noticed，主句谓语是shut down。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Engineers shut down the line；who noticed...修饰Engineers；that the valve was leaking是noticed的宾语从句。三个谓语分别属于不同层级。
exp.other: engineer 工程师；valve 阀门；leak 漏液；shut down 关闭、停运；subject head 主语中心词。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。阀门是that从句的主语，工程师才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the valve只在that从句中作主语；was leaking属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the line是shut down的宾语，不是主句主语。

questions.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
questions.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
questions.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It proves every member had opposed water conservation before joining.
It shows cooperatives necessarily control the national government.
It establishes that all unpopular policies eventually succeed.
It supports the claim that organized groups can facilitate policy implementation.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 成员加入前态度没有交代；合作社对国家政府的控制与本文无关；一次成功试行不能保证所有政策最终成功。

questions.target: causal direction / known vs unknown outcome
questions.skill: 区分已知原因、措施与尚未验证的后续结果
questions.q: A grant committee extended an application deadline after several applicants missed it. The report says the effect on later participation has not been measured. Which summary is justified?
o: The missed deadline prompted an extension; later participation effects remain unmeasured.
Later participation figures prompted the committee to extend the earlier deadline.
The extension caused applicants to miss a deadline that had already passed.
Officials changed the deadline only after a separate review showed participation had fallen.

exp.trans: 几名申请者错过截止日期后，拨款委员会延长了申请期限。报告说，尚未测量这一调整对后续参与情况的影响。最准确的概括是：错过截止日期促成了延期，但延期对后续参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: extended是主句谓语；after several applicants missed it交代延期的时间背景和触发情境；the effect...has not been measured明确限制了对后续结果的推断。
exp.other: grant committee 拨款委员会；application deadline 申请截止日期；participation 参与；measure 测量、评估。
exp.meaning: 必须区分已知的原因与尚未测量的后果。原文支持错过期限后发生延期，但不支持断言延期一定提高或降低后续参与。
exp.rest: 后续参与数据没有促成前面的延期；延期不可能导致申请者错过一个已经过去的截止日期；原文没有提到另一次审查或参与人数下降。

questions.skill: 不靠历史法案名称，判断证据支持的权力主体
questions.q: In a dispute over food labelling, a dissenting judge cites an old statute as a strong defense of national supervision and uses it to challenge a province's claim of exclusive authority. What does the historical reference support?
o: The judge treats the statute as a neutral date in the dispute's history.
The statute supports the province's exclusive control of labelling rules.
The judge uses earlier law to defend national regulatory authority.
The judge believes the statute makes all newer supervision unnecessary.

exp.trans: 在食品标签争议中，一位持异议的法官引用旧法，将其作为国家监督权的有力辩护，用来反驳某省认为自己拥有独占权限的主张。历史材料在这里支持国家监管权。
exp.structure: cites an old statute as...说明引用材料被赋予的论证功能；uses it to challenge...说明它反对的一方。本题与原文支持州权的例子相反，应按当前措辞判断。
exp.other: dissenting judge 持异议法官；statute 成文法；supervision 监督；exclusive authority 独占权限；province 省。
exp.meaning: 历史法案的名称和年代不是推理依据；需要追踪谁引用它、引用它支持谁、反驳谁。这里强调national supervision，不是地方自治。
exp.rest: 材料并非中立年代标记；省的独占监管主张正被质疑；没有证据表明旧法使所有后续监管失去必要性。

text4-federal-state-boundary.target: parallel rule / occupied the field / field pre-emption
text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 区分并行规则、直接冲突与领域排除
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A national safety code covers the whole field of product labelling. A state adds a parallel rule, and a court invalidates it because the code has “occupied the field.” Which explanation best fits the ruling?
o: The rule failed because another state's policy directly contradicted it.
The rule was pre-empted because national law already covered the field.
The rule was approved because parallel rules can never conflict.
The court delayed the case until lawmakers revised the enforcement budget.

exp.trans: 国家安全规范全面覆盖了产品标签领域。某州又增加了一项并行规定，法院因为国家规范已经“占据了该领域”而判定州规定无效。最合适的解释是：国家法律已全面规制该领域，因此州规定被排除。
exp.structure: A national safety code covers the whole field；第二句由and连接州增加规定与法院判定无效的动作；because从句给出判决理由。occupied the field是法律语境中的领域排除概念。
exp.other: product labelling 产品标签；invalidate 判定无效；pre-empt 排除州层面的规制；enforcement budget 执法预算。
exp.meaning: parallel表示并行，不等于contradict。即使没有逐条直接冲突，若国家立法已经全面覆盖该领域，州规定仍可能被排除。
exp.rest: 另一州的政策不是本案依据；parallel rules can never conflict把并行绝对化；法院已经作出无效判决，并非等待预算调整。

text4-federal-state-boundary.target: knock out / contested provisions / field preemption
text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 法律词组放回语境 + 联邦与州权限边界
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A legal report says the court 'knocked out' three contested provisions in a state's licensing plan. The judgment adds that the national legislature had already 'occupied the field,' although the state rules did not directly contradict one specific national clause. Which paraphrase best captures the reasoning?
o: The court delayed the dispute because the rules were too complicated.
The court struck down the rules because national law covered this field.
The court approved the rules as harmless additions to national policy.
The court found that the state had contradicted two other states' own laws.

exp.trans: 法院推翻了州计划中的争议条款，因为国家立法已经全面覆盖该领域。
exp.structure: knocked out表示推翻；contested provisions是有争议的条款；although引导让步，说明即使没有直接违反某一条具体规定，也可能因为occupied the field而被排除。
exp.other: knock out 推翻、使无效；contested 有争议的；provision 法律条款；occupy the field 全面覆盖某一立法领域。
exp.meaning: 判决的理由不是其他州的政策，也不是条款太复杂，而是国家立法已经全面规制该领域。parallel不自动等于contradict。
exp.rest: 延期审理与法院已经推翻条款不符；批准条款与invalidates相反；原文没有说州政策违反了另外两个州的法律。

text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 区分并行规定、直接冲突与领域排除
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A national law creates a comprehensive safety-label system for medical devices. A state adds a parallel labelling rule. A court invalidates the state provision because the national law has occupied the field. Which inference is strongest?
o: Any state rule that resembles a national rule is automatically invalid.
The state provision can be pre-empted even without a direct contradiction because national regulation has occupied the field.
The ruling shows that the state policy violated another state's law.
The court concluded that the national safety law has no authority.

exp.trans: 国家法律建立了全面的医疗器械安全标签制度。某州又增加了一项并行的标签规定。法院因为国家法律已经全面覆盖该领域而判定州规定无效。最有力的推断是：即使没有直接矛盾，州规定也可能因领域排除而不能成立。
exp.structure: creates与adds分别描述国家和州制定规则；because引出法院判决的原因。because the national law has occupied the field不是说两项规则必须逐字冲突，而是说明该领域已由国家立法全面规制。
exp.other: comprehensive 全面的；labelling 标签规定；invalidate 判定无效；pre-empt 排除与之不相容的州层面规制。
exp.meaning: parallel只表示并行或相应，并不自动等于contradict。判断权限问题时，要区分直接冲突与国家立法已占据整个领域这两种理由。
exp.rest: 把任何相似规定一概判无效过于绝对；另一州的法律没有被提及；国家法律具有权威正是判决理由的一部分，并非被否定。

conceivably.q: The damaged page could conceivably contain the date we need, but the faded ink cannot yet be read. Which claim keeps the writer’s certainty level?
o: 页面上已经确认写有需要的日期。
需要的日期很可能就在这一页，比其他页更有可能。
这页或许写有需要的日期，目前仍未证实。
这页故意省略了日期。

exp.trans: 那张受损的页面或许写有我们需要的日期，但褪色的墨迹目前还无法辨认。准确改写保留可能性，并说明尚未证实。
exp.structure: The damaged page是主语，could contain是谓语，the date是宾语；we need是省略关系代词的定语从句。conceivably修饰可能性；but之后the faded ink + cannot yet be read是被动谓语。
exp.other: damaged 受损的；faded 褪色的；ink 墨迹；certainty 确定程度。
exp.meaning: conceivably表示可以设想有这种可能。它既不是已经确认，也不自动表示比其他方案更可能。
exp.rest: “已经确认”抹掉could与无法辨认的限制；“很可能、比其他页更可能”加入原文没有的概率比较；“故意省略”把可能存在日期误写成有意不写，既换内容又补动机。

conceivably.q: No existing model explains the readings. They could conceivably point to a new process, although a faulty instrument remains another explanation. Which interpretation is justified?
o: A new process is a possible explanation, alongside an instrument fault.
The readings establish a new process and rule out an instrument fault.
The instrument fault has been confirmed by a separate test.
The new process is less likely than an instrument fault according to measured probabilities.

exp.trans: 现有模型都解释不了这些读数。它们或许指向一个新过程，但仪器故障仍是另一种解释。有依据的是两种解释仍可并存，新的过程只是可能性之一。
exp.structure: No existing model + explains + the readings。They指readings；could point to是谓语。although从句中a faulty instrument是主语，remains是系动词，another explanation是表语。
exp.other: reading 仪器读数；process 过程；faulty 出故障的；rule out 排除。
exp.meaning: conceivably没有把一种可设想的解释升级为发现。another explanation尤其限制了唯一性；也没有给两种解释排名。
exp.rest: establish ... rule out将可能性改成证实和排除；confirmed by a separate test虚构检验；less likely ... measured probabilities补出概率比较，原文没有量化数据。

summary-location.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It proves the article has reached its final sentence.
It summarizes the first phase before the article moves to further analysis.
It introduces a completely unrelated example.
It means the following claim is uncertain.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 总结词可以出现在文章中段，不能凭Overall就判断是最后一句；unrelated example是引例功能，与概括相反；Overall不表达不确定性，uncertain更接近possibly/apparently等语气词。

summary-location.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
summary-location.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

relative.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.q:
Applicants who believe that a longer résumé automatically proves greater ability often overlook the value of relevance.
哪组句法判断正确？
o: 主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 proves；主句谓语 believe
主句主语 a longer résumé；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 proves

diag.1: proves 属于 that 宾语从句，不是 who 从句的核心谓语；believe 也不是主句谓语。
diag.2: a longer résumé 是 that 从句内部的主语，不是整句主语。
diag.3: proves 是 that 从句谓语；整句主句谓语是 overlook。

exp.trans: 那些认为简历越长就自然能证明能力越强的申请者，往往忽视了“相关性”的价值。
exp.structure: 原始简单句① Applicants often overlook the value of relevance. ② Applicants believe something. ③ A longer résumé automatically proves greater ability. → ②把 something 换成 that 从句：Applicants believe that... → 再把②变成修饰 Applicants 的 who 定语从句：Applicants who believe that... often overlook...。所以整句主语 Applicants，who 从句谓语 believe，that 从句谓语 proves，主句谓语 overlook。
exp.other: applicant 申请者；résumé 简历；automatically 自然而然地/自动地；relevance 相关性。
exp.meaning: 看到 who 后先划到从句结束，再找主句谓语；who 从句里又可嵌套 that 宾语从句。
exp.rest: 把 that 从句的谓语 proves 误当成外层谓语，或把其中的 a longer résumé 误当成整句主语，都会错过：Applicants 是主句主语，believe 是 who 从句谓语，overlook 是主句谓语。

nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.q:
Residents who discovered that the shared gate was unlocked called the caretaker.
按“主句主语中心词 / who从句谓语 / 主句谓语”的顺序，哪组正确？
o: Residents / discovered / called
the shared gate / discovered / was
Residents / was unlocked / discovered
the caretaker / called / discovered

exp.trans: 发现公共大门没有锁上的住户给管理员打了电话。
exp.structure: 简单句①Residents called the caretaker. ②Residents discovered something. ③The shared gate was unlocked. → 把③接在discovered后：Residents discovered that the shared gate was unlocked. → 把重复的Residents换成who并嵌入①：Residents [who discovered [that the shared gate was unlocked]] called the caretaker。主句完整主语包含who从句，中心词是Residents。
exp.other: resident 住户；shared 共用的；unlocked 没锁上的；caretaker 管理员。
exp.meaning: 发现这件事的是住户；没有锁上的是大门；打电话给管理员的还是住户。三个小句的主语和谓语不能串层。
exp.rest: the shared gate只在that从句中作主语，不能升为主句主语。was unlocked属于that从句，discovered属于who从句；两者都不是主句谓语。the caretaker是called的宾语，不是发现大门未锁的人。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Editors who learned that the quote was inaccurate removed it from the draft. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Editors / learned / removed
the quote / learned / was
Editors / was / learned
the draft / removed / learned

exp.trans: 得知引文不准确的编辑把它从草稿中删掉了。主句主语中心词是Editors，who从句谓语是learned，主句谓语是removed。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Editors removed it from the draft；who learned...修饰Editors；that the quote was inaccurate是learned的宾语从句。三个谓语属于不同层级。
exp.other: editor 编辑；quote 引文；inaccurate 不准确的；draft 草稿。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。quote是that从句的主语，Editors才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the quote只在that从句中作主语；was属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the draft是介词from的宾语，不是主句主语。

example-claim-scope.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
example-claim-scope.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
example-claim-scope.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

example-claim-scope.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
example-claim-scope.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

example-claim-scope.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
example-claim-scope.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: A safety bonus can make a workplace more dangerous even when workers welcome it.
Anonymous surveys provide weaker safety evidence than official incident totals.
Workers respond more strongly to anonymity than to financial rewards.
Recorded events can increase because reporting changes, without a matching increase in hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 奖励后上报增多不能证明危险增多，调查反而指出发生频率未变；文中没有比较匿名调查和正式记录的证据等级；匿名是调查方式，奖励是先前制度变化，材料没有直接比较二者激励强度。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分记录数量变化与真实风险变化
example-claim-scope.q: After a factory introduced anonymous reporting, recorded safety events rose. Independent inspections found no increase in hazards. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The factory became more dangerous after anonymous reporting was introduced.
The rise in reports proves workers deliberately exaggerated safety incidents.
The higher event count may reflect reporting changes rather than more hazards.
Independent inspections confirmed that hazards increased throughout the factory.

exp.trans: 工厂引入匿名报告后，记录到的安全事件增加了，但独立检查没有发现危险因素增加。最有根据的结论是：记录数量的上升可能来自报告方式的变化，而非真实危险增加。
exp.structure: After引导时间背景；recorded safety events rose描述记录数；Independent inspections found no increase in hazards提供独立证据，限制了对真实风险的推断。
exp.other: anonymous reporting 匿名报告；recorded event 记录到的事件；independent inspection 独立检查；hazard 危险因素。
exp.meaning: 报告数量是观测到的数据，可能受报告机制影响；不能直接把记录数增加等同于真实危险增加。
exp.rest: 直接断言工厂更危险，与独立检查结果不符；把报告增加归因于故意夸大，原文没有动机证据；把检查结果说反了。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分报告数量变化与真实问题变化
example-claim-scope.q: A clinic switched to an online incident form, after which recorded reports rose. External audits found no increase in underlying faults. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The underlying fault rate rose because the clinic changed its form.
More recorded incidents may reflect easier reporting, not more faults.
External audits proved the old reporting system had been accurate.
The clinic changed the form after a separate review found fewer faults.

exp.trans: 诊所改用在线事件表单后，记录的报告增加了，但外部审计没有发现实际故障增加。记录数量的上升可能来自报告更容易，而不是故障变多。
exp.structure: A clinic switched...描述制度变化；after which引出其后的记录变化；External audits found...提供独立证据，限制对真实故障率的推断。
exp.other: incident form 事件报告表；recorded report 记录的报告；external audit 外部审计；underlying fault 实际故障。
exp.meaning: 观测到的报告数会受到报告渠道影响。记录数增加不能单独证明实际问题变多。
exp.rest: 表单变化本身不能证明故障率上升；审计没有证明旧系统完全准确；文中没有说改表单之前另一次审查发现故障减少。

causal-role-direction.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

causal-role-direction.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: The healthier seedlings caused the gardeners to provide shade.
Shade provided by the gardeners reduced the seedlings' exposure to heat.
The seedlings protected the gardeners from the heat.
The heat was reduced because the seedlings dried out.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: healthier seedlings caused...把结果当成原先行动的原因；seedlings protected gardeners交换了保护者与被保护者；heat was reduced because...反转因果，还把减少高温暴露偷换成降低环境温度。

causal-role-direction.target: 因果角色 / 作用方向
causal-role-direction.q: Trust in the complaints system was weakened by delays in acknowledging reports. Fewer residents subsequently used it. Which chain matches the account?
o: Lower use caused the earlier delays, which then improved trust.
Delays weakened trust; reduced use followed that loss of trust.
Residents’ increased trust made acknowledgement take longer.
Fewer reports showed that complaints had been resolved more quickly.

exp.trans: 投诉系统迟迟不确认收到报告，削弱了人们对它的信任。随后使用它的居民减少了。符合叙述的链条是：确认延迟削弱信任，使用减少随后发生。
exp.structure: Trust是主语；was weakened是被动谓语；by delays标明导致信任下降的因素。第二句Fewer residents是主语，used是谓语，it指投诉系统。subsequently给出时间方向。
exp.other: complaints system 投诉系统；acknowledge reports 确认收到报告；delay 延迟；subsequently 随后。
exp.meaning: 被动句的语法主语是受到影响的信任，不是施加影响的延迟。第二步是后续使用减少，不能倒转为原先延迟的起因。文本是对该链条的叙述，并未报告受控实验。
exp.rest: Lower use caused the earlier delays把后续使用减少倒置为较早事件的原因，且improved trust与weakened相反；increased trust同时交换方向和变化趋势；resolved more quickly把使用量下降替换成解决速度提升，原文没有处理速度数据。

causal-role-direction.target: 原因 / 应对措施 / 后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: After several small firms missed an application deadline, the council extended the next round by a week to give them another chance. Participation in that later round has not yet been measured. Which statement preserves the roles?
o: The extension made firms miss the earlier deadline.
The later participation figures caused the council to extend the round.
The missed deadline prompted an extension; its effect on later participation is still unknown.
The earlier deadline was introduced in response to the extension.

exp.trans: 几家小企业错过申请截止时间后，市政委员会将下一轮的期限延长一周，给它们再一次机会。后一轮的参与情况尚未统计。错过期限是延长期限这一应对措施的背景，措施对随后参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: after从句：several small firms + missed + an application deadline。主句：the council + extended + the next round，by a week表示延长量，to give them another chance说明目的。Participation + has not yet been measured是现在完成时被动谓语。
exp.other: firm 企业；application 申请；deadline 截止时间；participation 参与情况。
exp.meaning: 区分原先问题、事后应对和尚未观测的效果。不能让后来的措施成为较早失败的原因，也不能凭实施措施就宣称取得改善。
exp.rest: The extension made...让下一轮的措施反过来造成先前错过期限；later participation figures不存在已测量数据，不能成为依据；earlier deadline ... in response to the extension把较早规则与后来的回应倒置。

text4-historical-inference.target: historical reference / side supported by the argument
text4-historical-inference.skill: 从历史材料判断论证方向
text4-historical-inference.q: A dissenting judge calls an old statute a “strong defense of state privileges” and uses it to challenge a national ruling. What is the best inference about the judge's position?
o: The judge uses the statute to defend state authority against federal control.
The judge argues that states have no separate authority in this field.
The judge treats the statute as proof that every federal law is invalid.
The judge cites the statute only to explain the dispute's historical setting.

exp.trans: 一位持异议的法官把一项旧法案称为对州权的有力辩护，并用它来质疑国家层面的裁决。这表明该法官借此维护州的权限，反对联邦权力过度扩张。
exp.structure: A dissenting judge是主语；calls an old statute a strong defense...说明他如何描述该法案；uses it to challenge a national ruling进一步说明历史材料在论证中发挥的作用。
exp.other: dissenting 持异议的；statute 成文法；privileges 权限、特权；challenge 质疑、反对。
exp.meaning: 推断历史材料的作用，要看作者把它用于支持哪一方。这里明确把法案当作州权的辩护，而非联邦权力的依据。
exp.rest: 认为州没有独立权限与strong defense of state privileges相反；文中没有说所有联邦法律都无效；历史背景不是唯一目的，因为法官用该材料来挑战当前裁决。

text4-historical-inference.target: historical reference used to defend local powers
text4-historical-inference.skill: 历史背景的论证方向推断
text4-historical-inference.q: A dissenting judge describes an old coastal settlement act as part of a 'robust defense of local privileges' and uses it to challenge a national ruling. What does this suggest about the judge's position?
o: The judge uses the history to defend state authority against federal control.
The judge argues that states have no separate authority in this field.
The judge treats the act as proof that every federal law is invalid.
The judge cites the act only to explain the dispute's historical background.

exp.trans: 法官把历史法案用于有力地维护州的权限，反对联邦控制。
exp.structure: A dissenting judge是主语；describes...as...说明法官如何定位历史法案；uses it to challenge a national ruling说明引用历史材料的论证方向。
exp.other: dissenting 持异议的；robust 有力的；state privileges 州权；challenge 质疑、反对。
exp.meaning: 推断历史材料的作用，要看它支持哪一方。这里的关键是对州权的辩护，而不是法案名称本身。
exp.rest: 认为州没有独立权限与对州权的辩护相反；没有证据证明所有联邦法律都无效；历史背景不是唯一目的，因为法官用它来质疑当前裁决。

text4-historical-inference.target: historical evidence and the side it supports
text4-historical-inference.q: In a dispute over river management, a judge's dissent traces a 'strong defense of state privileges' back to an early national statute. What is the best inference?
o: The judge's argument favors state powers.
The judge says the statute stripped states of all authority.
The judge agrees national officials may cancel any state rule they dislike.
The judge is discussing only the technical cost of river management.

exp.trans: 在一场河流管理争议中，一位法官的异议意见把对州权的有力辩护追溯到一项早期国家法案。最合理的推断是，该法官的论证支持州的权力。
exp.structure: a judge's dissent是中心名词短语；traces...back to...表示追溯来源；strong defense of state privileges直接提示被辩护的一方是州。
exp.other: dissent 异议意见；trace back to 追溯到；strip someone of authority 剥夺某人的权限。
exp.meaning: 历史法案的名称或年代不是唯一线索；更重要的是作者把它用来支持哪一方。此处明确说的是对州权的辩护。
exp.rest: 剥夺州权与strong defense of state privileges相反；文中没有授权国家官员随意取消州规则；河流管理成本不是论证重点。
